preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of nodes N in each test case must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 1000000000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each node value A[i] must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes within the range of 1 to N.
The total number of nodes across all test cases must not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum security of the tree as a string.
The minimum security of the tree must be non-negative.
The security of every leaf node must be greater than 0 after operations.
